Every line of The Price is Right™'s prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.

2781.headline: How this game pays out

2782.body:
The prize money on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" leans toward the smaller prizes. It is spread over eight prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $1 million. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

Everything here about "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through November 13.
